body: Emirates has announced plans to replace the Boeing 777 on one of its three daily Dubai–Mauritius flights with its newest aircraft, the Airbus A350, as of November 1, 2026. The A350 will take over flights EK709 and EK710 between Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport (MRU) in Mauritius, while the airline's other two daily flights to the island will continue to be operated by Airbus A380s.

The daily A350 schedule, with all times local, has EK709 departing Dubai at 07:55 and arriving in Mauritius at 14:40, and EK710 departing Mauritius at 18:30 and arriving in Dubai at 01:10 the next day. The A350 seats 298 passengers: 32 in Business Class, 28 in Premium Economy and 238 in Economy, bringing Emirates' newest Business Class product to the Mauritius route for the first time, along with updated onboard technology.

Business Class is arranged in a 1-2-1 layout, giving every passenger direct aisle access, with fully flat seats, a 20-inch 4K screen, a personal mini-bar, wireless charging and Bulgari amenity kits, plus a self-service snack area at the rear of the cabin. Premium Economy has a 2-3-2 layout with 19.5-inch-wide seats, footrests, six-way adjustable headrests and 13.3-inch screens, along with priority boarding, a dedicated check-in area in Dubai and a baggage allowance of up to 35 kilograms, while Economy seats feature adjustable leather headrests and 13.3-inch 4K touchscreens with Bluetooth connectivity.

Emirates' Manager for the Indian Ocean Islands, Oomar Ramtoola, said the A350 marks another important step in the airline's investment in Mauritius and, together with the two daily A380 flights, shows the importance of the island within Emirates' network. All three of Emirates' daily Mauritius flights now offer Premium Economy, and in Dubai passengers can connect to more than 70 destinations across Europe, Asia and the Americas.
en.summary: From November 1, 2026, Emirates will replace the Boeing 777 on one of its three daily Dubai–Mauritius flights with the Airbus A350, operating EK709 and EK710 with 298 seats across three cabins, including its newest Business Class on the route for the first time.
en.title: Emirates puts its A350 with new Business Class on Dubai–Mauritius from November 1, replacing a 777 on EK709/710

body: 阿聯酋航空宣布，自2026年11月1日起，將把每日3班杜拜—模里西斯航班中的1班，由波音777改為最新機型空中巴士A350執飛。A350將執飛杜拜國際機場與模里西斯西沃薩古爾拉姆古蘭國際機場之間的EK709與EK710航班，該航空公司飛往該島的另外每日2班航班則繼續由空中巴士A380執飛。
A350每日時刻表皆為當地時間：EK709於07:55自杜拜起飛、14:40抵達模里西斯，EK710於18:30自模里西斯起飛、翌日01:10抵達杜拜。A350共載客298人，包括商務艙32席、豪華經濟艙28席與經濟艙238席，首度把阿聯酋航空最新的商務艙產品帶到模里西斯航線，同時帶來更新的機上科技。
商務艙採1-2-1配置，每位旅客皆可直接進出走道，座椅可完全平躺，配備20吋4K螢幕、個人迷你吧、無線充電與寶格麗盥洗包，機艙後方另設自助點心區。豪華經濟艙採2-3-2配置，座椅寬19.5吋，附腳靠、六向可調頭靠與13.3吋螢幕，並享有優先登機、杜拜專用報到區與最高35公斤的行李額度；經濟艙座椅則配備可調式皮革頭靠與13.3吋4K觸控螢幕，並支援藍牙連接。
阿聯酋航空印度洋島嶼經理歐瑪拉姆圖拉表示，A350是該航空公司投資模里西斯的另一個重要里程碑，加上每日2班A380航班，顯示該島在阿聯酋航空航網中的重要性。目前阿聯酋航空每日3班模里西斯航班皆提供豪華經濟艙，旅客在杜拜可轉機前往歐洲、亞洲與美洲超過70個目的地。
zh.summary: 2026年11月1日起，阿聯酋航空將把每日3班杜拜—模里西斯航班中的1班由波音777改為空中巴士A350執飛EK709與EK710，全機298席共3艙等，並首度在該航線推出全新商務艙產品。
